mil7.8.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, chattassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. - Yathā mahārāja chattaṃ uparimuddhani carati, evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kilesānaṃ uparimuddhani-carena bhavitabbaṃ. Idaṃ mahārāja chattassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.3:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja chattaṃ muddhanupatthambhaṃ hoti, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena yoniso manasikārupatthambhena bhavitabbaṃ. Idaṃ mahārāja chattassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.3:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja chattaṃ vātātapameghavuṭṭhiyo paṭihanti, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena nānāvidhadiṭṭhi-puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ matavāta-tividhaggisantāpa-kilesavuṭṭhiyo paṭihantabbā. Idaṃ mahārāja chattassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ. Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā:
mil7.8.3:4.1: Yathā pi chattaṃ vipulaṃ acchiddaṃ thirasaṃhataṃ vātātapaṃ nivāreti, mahatī devavuṭṭhiyo,
mil7.8.3:5.1: Tath' eva Buddhaputto pi sīlacchattadharo suci kilesavuṭṭhiṃ vāreti santāpatividhaggayo ti.
